name: Kinnaur: Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa
one_line: Himachal Pradesh, up the Sutlej on the old Hindustan-Tibet road, then the Baspa valley to Chitkul

highway.value: NH 5 from Rampur to Reckong Peo; side roads to Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa

fuel.note: Pumps are those drawn on the open map within the search radius of the road. A pump missing from the map is missing here, so each gap is a worst case.

rules.title: Kinnaur and Spiti: no permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: Indian citizens ride through with a photo identity card, shown at check posts. The district page asks every visitor to carry identity. No separate order was found.
rules.set_by: Not stated on an official page; reported by a rider blog

source.title: Inner Line Permits for Kinnaur, Lahaul and Spiti Valley

rules.title: Protected area permit for foreign citizens, Pooh to Kaza
rules.detail: Applies in Pooh block, beyond this route. A rider blog says Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa need none. Kinnaur's page: groups of two, thirty days, Rs 200 each.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs; issued by District Magistrates and Sub-Divisional Magistrates

history.change: Lahaul and Spiti district page still states a minimum of four foreign citizens sponsored by a travel agency.

source.title: Foreigner Section, District Lahaul and Spiti

history.change: Kinnaur district page states groups of two or more, agency sponsorship and a thirty-day limit.
Rider blog reports offices issue fifteen days in practice and sometimes accept solo applicants at Reckong Peo, Pooh and Kaza.

source.title: Inner Line Permits for Kinnaur, Lahaul and Spiti Valley

rules.title: Kinnaur: carry identity; border roads are out of bounds
rules.detail: Every visitor carries a valid identity card. Roads towards Shipki La and Kaurik are closed to visitors, and security installations may not be photographed.

rules.title: Chitkul is the last point reachable without a permit
rules.detail: The road beyond Chitkul runs towards the border and is not open to visitors. Stated by an encyclopedia page; no order was found.

rules.title: Himachal entry toll for vehicles from other states
rules.detail: Charged at entry barriers under the yearly toll policy. Notified rates name passenger and goods vehicles only. The Chief Minister said two-wheelers stay exempt. The policy document was not opened.
rules.set_by: Department of State Taxes and Excise, Government of Himachal Pradesh

source.title: Himachal toll tax rates revised: Here's what you need to know

history.change: Toll Policy 2026-27 announced with higher rates from 1 April 2026; receipt reported valid 24 hours across the state.

source.title: Himachal Pradesh revises toll tax rates. Here's how much vehicle entry fee you'll have to pay from April 1

history.change: Chief Minister told the assembly the tax would be reviewed and that light vehicles and two-wheelers remain exempt.

source.title: Himachal Govt signals rethink on entry tax

history.change: Revised rates reported, with a lower rate for passenger vehicles from other states; two-wheelers not listed.

source.title: Himachal toll tax rates revised: Here's what you need to know

season.note: No pass closes this route; Chitkul and the upper Baspa valley lie under snow in winter and the highway is cut by landslides in the monsoon.

authorities.office: Himachal Pradesh Public Works Department, National Highway wing

hazards.title: Nigulsari and Chaura landslide zone on NH 5
hazards.detail: Repeated slides cut Kinnaur off from Shimla, once for about ten days. Debris keeps falling while crews work.

source.title: 3rd landslide on NH-5 at Kinnaur in a month; debris cleared, traffic restored

hazards.title: Highway collapse at Nigulsari, autumn 2024
hazards.detail: A landslip broke the highway and stranded tourist vehicles and apple trucks on both sides.

source.title: Kinnaur cut off after landslip at Negulsari

hazards.title: Chitkul under snow in winter
hazards.detail: The village is mostly snow-covered in winter and residents move lower down.

gaps: Himachal entry toll: the two-wheeler exemption rests on a newspaper report of the Chief Minister's statement (26 March 2026). The official Toll Policy 2026-27 document on hptax.gov.in failed to open (certificate error), so it is not confirmed for motorcycles registered in other states.
No official source found for the road numbers of the Karcham to Sangla to Chitkul road or the Reckong Peo to Kalpa road.
No dated source found for winter closures of the Sangla to Chitkul road.
No source found for hazards on the Karcham to Sangla road itself.
That lower Kinnaur needs no permit for foreign citizens is stated by a rider blog only.
Videos: titles and channels were read from the video pages; filming dates and motorcycles are not confirmed.
